text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Keep going straight ahead. Okay... And
stop.
Now remove your blindfolds!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother... Welcome to your
celebration!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Did you prepare all this for us,
Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And all my friends helped out! We
prepared
more than just this venue for
you, though.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um, okay! We're ready, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! Welcome to your party! ♪ I'm
Curren,
your stylist for today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We have a chic suit for the gentleman,
and a pure white, A-line dress for the
lady. I used the outfits you wore during
your wedding ceremony as
inspiration. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this brings back memories! Your
friends
arranged this for us as well?
Incredible...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Here's the food we
prepared
for you! It's a full course of
French cuisine from a
popular restaura—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I spilled the soup! Wh-what should I do?!
I have to
clean it up and get another
serving!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Rice is going to run herself
ragged again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Can you please help me out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Could someone please go to the kitchen
and
prepare another bowl of soup? I'll
clean up this
mess!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Just leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll handle the cleaning, Rice. ♪ Don't
you think
it's about time you get ready
for you-know-what?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to continue with the
proceedings while
we wait for your food
to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, thank you. So you're here to help
out Rice
as well?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's the very least we could do for her,
since Rice
does so much for us.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to make everyone happy
provides us
with more emotional support
than I can describe.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Our Rice really does all that...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We were thrilled when she asked us to
aid her in
doing something for the two
special people she
loves so much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe the time has arrived. If you
would please
direct your attention to
the stage.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother. I'm sorry for always
causing you
so much trouble...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not right... I want to thank
you... Thank
you for always caring so
much about me.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And... thank you to everyone for helping
me out
with this party. I'm so happy right
now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought that I was a burden
to you all
since I'm always messing things
up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to everyone, I finally realized
that asking for help and being relied on
aren't burdens
to bear—they're
opportunities to cherish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to do my best to make
you all
happy! Here's to looking out for
each other from
now on as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of grand applause and the
joyful
weeping of Rice Shower's parents
reverberate
throughout the party venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to Tracen Academy, I
overhear a discussion between Rice
Shower's parents, who
happen to be
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how much Rice has grown
up. I'm
delighted, but it's a bittersweet
feeling, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It is. But nothing will ever change the
fact that
she's our daughter. Just look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is reluctant to part with her
parents even briefly and continues to
wave vigorously
until the two of them
disappear from view.
